races.display_title: AIS Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: GLANCING JACK 's Newbury handicap debut second in March is strong form and he can make a successful reappearance for new trainer Dan Skelton. High Fibre 's excellent start for the James Owen yard includes a Summer Hurdle win at Market Rasen and a fourth in the Cesarewitch at Newmarket last month so he's an obvious threat. Keno Black has a similar profile to his yard's 2024 winner of this and is next on the list ahead of Norman Fletcher and unexposed Paul Nicholls handicap newcomer Outmaster . GLANCING JACK HIGH FIBRE (IRE) KENO BLACK (FR)

JONBON (FR) GIDLEIGH PARK SAINT SEGAL (FR)

races.verdict: WAY OF STARS looks to have plenty in his favour in a stacked renewal, and he may well gain compensation for his Chepstow near miss. The main danger could be handicap debutant Lexington Wood , who has plenty of untapped potential, while Dan Skelton's Sytadel is another who is probably well treated. Eben Zaabeel is potentially most interesting of a healthy Irish contingent, his shrewd connections landing a touch in this corresponding race back in 2013. races.display_title: Christmas Party Nights At Dundalk Stadium Handicap
races.verdict: Cases can be made for plenty of these so it could pay to take a chance on DAAMBERDIPLOMAT , who was last seen in winning action here in October last year and returns from just 1 lb higher having since joined the shrewd Ado McGuinness outfit. Caffu Zafeen arrives in search of a 5-timer, so he merits considerable respect, with All The Girls and Eddie G another couple worth considering, as well. DAAMBERDIPLOMAT (IRE) CAFFU ZAFEEN (IRE) ALL THE GIRLS (IRE)
